# Fight balance simulation

**A proposal, generated by `npm run sim:fights`. Do not edit by hand.** Input hash: `c15f13c174e5d4c4` (lib/fight-content.ts, lib/fight-sim.ts, scripts/sim-fights.ts). 120 spars a family in the main table. Deterministic: seeded spars, no clock. What the numbers mean and the decisions they support: [fight-content.md](fight-content.md).

Limits: the "smart" player looks one turn ahead with rolls at their mean; rivals play today's `chooseAI`; intents (F2) are not modelled; specials are used by a fixed rule in the simple line; decks are a fixed middling deck per level, not a rested player's random one. Win rates against these rivals measure the content against itself, not what a person will feel.

Rested specials: REST SLEEP IT OFF (Heal 3 per pip; with three pips, guard too.); ROAM SECOND WIND (+1 energy per pip (energy still caps at 3); with three pips, draw 1.); FOCUS IN THE ZONE (Your next damaging card this turn: +1 power per pip, ignores guard.).
